title: Loose impressions
description: A trail of small relief prints follows movement through an exhibition field with three prints visible at rest.
useCase: Let a portfolio reveal a visual collection through exploration without taking over the page.
interaction: Move through the field or place a print
reducedMotion: Live reduced-motion preferences remove interpolation and decorative playback. All content and native controls remain available. Keyboard changes settle immediately.
limitations: Original demonstration content; adapt labels and state to the host product.
look: Warm stone-grey page with a large muted olive serif headline, tilted cream-matted abstract prints with soft shadows, and a thin-ruled text button along the bottom.
motion: Mouse movement drops a tilted print after every 7% of travel; each pops in from 0.85 scale over 300 ms ease-out, older prints fade, and six remain at most.
adapt: `place` adds a print when the pointer moves 7% from `last`, keeps six via `slice(-5)` and derives each `angle` from its `id`; entry is the `sf-impression-in` keyframes. Replace the `.impression` CSS artwork with real images and rewrite the `.word` headline.
